title: Nextera joins AMD at their booth at the 2024 Robotics Summit in Boston, MA
summary: Nextera joined partner AMD at their booth at the 2024 Robotics Summit in Boston, MA
body_markdown: Nextera joined their longtime partner AMD at their booth at the 2024 Robotics Summit & Expo held at the Boston Convention and Exhibition Center in Boston, MA. Displayed at a booth was a Didge rover powered by AMD’s technology. During a scheduled presentation given by AMD to an audience of enthused robotics fans, Didge was a featured section to exemplify the technology of the future being used today.
